# TradingGYM

> A trading simulator and learning platform for financial markets. Practice futures trading risk-free, follow structured learning tiers, and learn from independent trading educators (Gurus).

TradingGYM helps traders build muscle memory through realistic chart replay, scenario-based practice, and a curriculum that progresses from foundations to advanced strategies. No real money is at risk — all trading is simulated.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of the TradingGYM simulator and learning platform.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Subscription plans and feature comparison.
- [Gurus Directory](/gurus): Browse independent trading educators offering classes and coaching.
- [Sign in / Sign up](/auth): Create an account or log in.
